description: Change listing, badge, title, tags, password, storage, hosting, link name or Page data on an owned publication. Use a disruptive action alone. Ask before make_private or make_public: the current address stops working.

action.description: Use alone. make_private and make_public move it to a new address; make_private and rotate_link end the old address and any link name for good; make_private detaches a custom domain

badgeHidden.description: Hide or show the BrewPage badge

extend.description: Set true to extend storage to the profile limit

linkName.description: Readable name for the public link of a page, site or file: 6-20 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, with a letter; null removes it. Needs a profile token, or an owner token added to a free BrewPage profile

listed.description: List or unlist an eligible public publication

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

state.description: {} enables Page data, named rules merge, null disables and keeps entries

tags.description: Your private tags, replacing the set; [] clears. Up to 10, 1-32 characters, no commas, saved lowercase. Needs a profile publication

title.description: One-line title; empty restores the content title

name: publication_settings
title: Change publication settings
